description:
FILED s507b (Opus, 2026-10-04) from member 4's (#2684) breaking-case probes; PRE-EXISTING on main 08de9e4f.

REPRODUCER (f1 = "a\nb\n", f2 = "c\n", f3 = "d\ne\n"):
  pcl -ne 'print "$ARGV:$.:$_" if eof()' f1 f2 f3
  perl: f3:5:e                     PCL: f1:2:b / f2:3:c / f3:5:e   (bare `eof` gives all three in both)
CAUSE (measured): `./pl2cl` emits `(p-eof)` for both `eof` and `eof()`; perlfunc: "eof() with empty parentheses
... detects the end of the last file of `<>`" -- it is a test of the whole @ARGV stream (perl opens the next file
to look), while bare `eof` tests the last-read handle.
FIX DIRECTION: the parser must keep the empty-parens spelling distinct (a different form, e.g. (p-eof-argv)), and
the runtime answers "current <> file at EOF AND no further @ARGV file has a record" (perl's nextargv peek; an empty
@ARGV at the very start means STDIN).  Probe: eof() before the first read, between files, with -i, with an
unreadable file in @ARGV.  Probe script: worktree agent-abf54c6d69793c324 scratch/s507b/m4/ip.sh.


=== DONE (s507c, built s508, shipped s509) ===
ExprToCL: an `eof` / `CORE::eof` head whose next sibling is an EMPTY List emits (p-eof-argv) (the parse keeps no trace of the parens; the head token's sibling does).  Runtime p-eof-argv: loop -- no current file -> %p-argv-advance (nil = all consumed -> true); current at EOF -> %p-argv-drop-current; else false.  %p-argv-advance / %p-argv-drop-current are the reader's own open/close steps, extracted (one copy).  Probed = perl: between files (opens the next, $ARGV moves), an unreadable and an empty file, STDIN with empty @ARGV, -i (END printed after the last file goes to STDOUT), post-loop.  Guard Pl/t/diamond-01.t row 7.
Review F3 (Fable s509): `eof(ARGV)` / `eof ARGV` read the filehandle table, which still held an earlier closed file, so they answered true on a non-last line; %p-argv-designator-p routes an ARGV designator to *p-argv-stream* while <> runs.  Guard diamond-01.t row 8.  fileio-01.t asserted eof() -> (p-eof) (the bug); now (p-eof-argv) plus a bare-eof row.
subject: SILENT WRONG (PRE-EXISTING): `eof()` WITH empty parens is the same as bare `eof` -- both compile to (p-eof) -- so `print if eof()` under <> fires at the end of EVERY file; perl's eof() is true only at the end of the LAST file
